reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added SourceNamespaces filters destinations (envoy clusters) for unreachable routes", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Environments using SourceNamespaces in traffic routing will now have filtering applied to envoy cluster selection for unreachable routes, changing destination selection behavior.

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds SourceNamespaces filtering of destination (envoy cluster) selection for unreachable routes.
